markdownDescription:
## Fashion Film Studio

One model, one gown, two productions. Each scene is one sentence you can rewrite: it becomes an opening still, and the still becomes an 8-second slow-motion fashion film. Same woman, same gown, two worlds — the sentence is the director.

1. **Model photo + Model notes** — the person in plain basics, and a written description that locks her face, hair, tattoos and rings.
2. **Garment photo** — the gown. An AI writes it down once so it never drifts between scenes.
3. **Scene 1** — a runway on a salt flat at sunset: brief → opening still → film.
4. **Scene 2** — a black studio with a wind machine and strobes: the same three steps.
5. Rewrite a brief and rerun its row; add a third row for a third scene.

data.text: The photo shows the person in plain basics on grey, so the template can dress her. The notes describe her in words — eyes, bob, skin, tattoos, rings, earrings — and every still quotes them next to the photo, so the face never drifts. Swap the photo and rewrite the notes for another person.

data.text: A striking woman in her late twenties to early thirties with piercing pale blue eyes and a sleek, chin-length black bob with a center part that frames her angular, high-cheekboned face. Her skin is a warm medium-tan tone with a smooth, luminous finish. She has a slim, model-lean build with long elegant fingers adorned with multiple chunky silver rings on both hands. Her most distinctive features are extensive dark floral and botanical tattoos covering both forearms and hands in dense, intricate sleeve-style patterns. She wears bold cobalt-blue resin drop earrings that complement her eye color. Her brows are dark, well-defined, and slightly arched, and her lips are full with a natural rosy-nude tone.
data.label: Model notes
Garment notes
data.userInput: Describe the gown in the reference image. If the image shows several photos, they all show the same gown.
data.systemPrompt: You write garment descriptions for an image and video generator. Look at the reference image and describe the gown in ONE paragraph of 50–70 words, plain declarative English: silhouette, bodice and neckline, sleeves or shoulders, ruffles or drapes, colours, fabrics and their finish, waist, skirt and length. Only what is visible. Ignore the person, the jewellery and the background. No brand names, no opinions, no bullet points, no commentary. Output only the paragraph.

data.text: A runway on a white salt flat at sunset — one straight line to the horizon under a warm low sun. She does a runway walk straight toward the camera, the wind pulling at the gown, everything in slow motion, the camera low and gliding backwards in front of her. At the end she stops, strikes a pose and looks into the lens.
